note: Pinned FRP release for the ShareBridge relay module. The fetch script downloads exactly these URLs over HTTPS, verifies the SHA-256 digests of both the release tarball and the frps executable it contains, and stages frps/frpc into a version+digest-keyed cache. The frps_sha256 fields pin the extracted server executable itself: they are the reference the installer compares every candidate and every installed copy against, so a poisoned cache marker or a tampered staged binary can never be accepted. FRP binaries are never committed; release packaging bundles executables verified through this manifest. Pin approved by the user after official upstream checksum verification.
